title: Billboard / More than mail
slide_intent: Acknowledge a limiting association directly because people need a reason to revise what they think a brand offers.
strategic_value: The self-aware name joke can help Mailchimp communicate expansion beyond email while retaining humor.
demonstration: A large yellow street billboard pairs an unusual hand drawing with a two-line message about the name and broader offer, followed by the logo.
practical_value: Compare how a concise joke, product scope and brand signature share a billboard.
